<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
  <meta name="description" content="">
  <title>Untitled</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:,">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; text-size-adjust: 100%; scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    :target { scroll-margin-block: 1rem; }
    body {
      margin: 0 auto;
      max-width: 65ch;
      padding: 1rem;
      font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    input, button, textarea, select { font: inherit; }
    h1, h2, h3 { line-height: 1.2; text-wrap: balance; }
    p { text-wrap: pretty; }
    p, li, h1, h2, h3 { overflow-wrap: break-word; }
    img, svg, video, canvas, picture { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
    img, video { height: auto; }
    pre, code, kbd, samp { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; }
    pre { overflow-x: auto; tab-size: 2; }
    table { border-collapse: collapse; }
    th, td { padding: 0.25em 0.5em; text-align: start; vertical-align: top; }
    sub, sup { line-height: 0; }
    a { text-underline-offset: 0.15em; }
    button:not(:disabled), [role="button"], summary, label[for] { cursor: pointer; }
    textarea { resize: vertical; }
    [hidden] { display: none !important; }
    :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <main>
  </main>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
I made some small changes to `0.html`. It was already a good starter template with no page content, so there wasn't much to fix. I haven't opened it in a browser.

- **Smooth scrolling** now only turns on when the user hasn't asked for reduced motion. Before, it was always on and then switched off by an override.
- **Page height:** the body now fills at least the full screen height (`100svh`).
- **Smaller defaults:**
  - Tables now span the full width.
  - Table captions are left-aligned and bold.
  - Horizontal rules (`<hr>`) are thin, faint lines.
  - Abbreviations with a `title` get a dotted underline and a help cursor.
  - Selected text uses the system highlight colours.
  - Text on Mac is rendered slightly thinner.

The `<title>` still says "Untitled", the description is still blank, and `<main>` is still empty. If you tell me what the page is for, I can fill in the title, description and content, or add a header, navigation or footer.
